tier-1-native.preconditions: Supported Linux ELF x86-64 input with a safe candidate region.
tier-1-native.invariants: Loader validity and declared runtime observables remain unchanged.
tier-1-native.instructions_affected: Pass-specific x86-64 rules exercised by native fixtures.
tier-1-native.false_positive_risk: Candidate analysis and post-mutation validation reduce but do not eliminate false positives.
tier-1-native.performance: Not recorded per pass in the public corpus.
tier-1-native.compatibility: Pass combinations are not exhaustively covered.

experimental.preconditions: Input-specific preconditions are documented by the implementation and may reject the sample.
experimental.invariants: Structural validity is required; complete runtime parity is not yet established for every path.
experimental.compatibility: Composition with other passes is not contractually supported.

code-virtualization.preconditions: Whole-function semantics plus CFG, SSA, and complete liveness coverage must be proven; unsupported capabilities are rejected before mutation.
code-virtualization.invariants: VM output retains loader validity and must match emulator and bounded runtime observables.
code-virtualization.instructions_affected: Supported memory, calls/returns, stack/ABI, TLS, signals, threads, floating-point, SIMD, flags, and dispatch subsets; unsupported instructions and exception/unwinding metadata produce diagnostics.
code-virtualization.false_positive_risk: Conservative pre-transform rejection is measured by bounded diagnostics; independent false-positive rates are not available.
code-virtualization.performance: Transform and runtime durations are recorded in docs/protection-maturity-corpus.json.
code-virtualization.decompiler_effectiveness: Evidence is recorded in docs/protection-maturity.md; independent cross-tool coverage is incomplete.
code-virtualization.compatibility: Only Linux ELF x86-64 functions satisfying the preconditions are in scope.

experimental-corpus-selected.preconditions: Input-specific preconditions are documented by the implementation and may reject the sample; selected passes are exercised by the compatibility corpus.
experimental-corpus-selected.invariants: Structural validity and bounded runtime parity are measured by the compatibility corpus for selected passes.
experimental-corpus-selected.false_positive_risk: Corpus application and omission counts are recorded; independent false-positive rates remain unavailable.
experimental-corpus-selected.performance: Per-pass output-size, transform-duration, runtime-duration, and observable parity summaries are recorded by the compatibility corpus workflow.
experimental-corpus-selected.decompiler_effectiveness: Analyzer-effectiveness evidence is aggregated by the adversarial benchmark; independent cross-tool coverage remains incomplete.
experimental-corpus-selected.compatibility: Selected-pass composition is measured by scheduled corpus campaigns; arbitrary pass combinations remain unsupported.
